description: Trigger: gc_candidates.rs select_gc_candidates() evaluates policy.should_pin() for each row and returns only candidates where should_pin is false. Then gc.rs run_once() calls policy.should_pin() again on the same candidates before deciding to unpin. Bad behavior: the double evaluation is not documented. If the policy object passed to select_gc_candidates differs from the one in run_once (e.g. due to a future refactor), some articles will be double-filtered and some may never be GC'd despite being eligible. The code should be made self-consistent: either filter in SQL+Rust once, or document explicitly that run_once re-evaluates.
title: gc_candidates policy evaluation applied twice: once in select_gc_candidates and once in run_once
